name: Browser Extension Architecture Audit

architecture_recommendation.url_capture: chrome.tabs.query({active: true, currentWindow: true}) inside popup.js

predict_contract.response_schema: PredictionResponse with risk_level, confidence, risk_score, recommendation, whois, ssl, redirect, virustotal, explainability, forensic_report

duplicate_scan_strategy: Disable scan button while request is running, use simple client-side throttling.
timeout_strategy: Implement client-side timeout of ~10s. If backend fails, show user-friendly error.
error_handling_strategy: Catch all network/HTTP errors. Do not expose tracebacks. Display friendly message.
